caption: The drawing shows a single axe head positioned horizontally across the center of a plain, light beige background. The axe head is colored mostly in shades of dark brown, with distinct decorative geometric patterns. The left end, which appears to be the socket for the handle, features a series of triangle and line motifs rendered in lighter hues, including blue, white, and reddish-brown. The blade portion, to the right, has a noticeable diamond-shaped inlay or engraving closer to its base, outlined in white and filled in grayish blue. Multiple horizontal bands with alternating colors separate the patterned socket area from the larger, gently curved cutting blade. There is no detailing or shading elsewhere in the image, and the axe head is isolated in the composition with the artist's signature, "C. Christoffels," inscribed just below and slightly to the right of the object.
title: Tomahawk
